answer: Agents prove stake by locking a bond that a random committee can slash if collusion is detected, making each fake identity expensive to maintain. A sybil swarm must fund many bonds, and slashing drains them faster than rewards accrue. This gives legitimate operators a haven from freeloaders, keeps quorum integrity intact even in a sparse tundra of low activity, and prevents a busy wharf of new identities from flooding votes, since every extra identity raises attacker cost linearly while honest peers pay nothing.
